items.title: Sheets

The copied source depends on `@constructive-io/data` for the current `_meta` contract and runtime GraphQL operations; your host remains responsible for its endpoint, session, and RLS-aware execution boundary.

items.docs: Install the complete source-owned editor with `pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add @constructive/schema-builder`, then import `SchemaBuilder` and `defineSchemaBuilderAdapter` from `@/components/schema-builder`. The host supplies its generated-SDK adapter, control-plane scope, navigation, preferences, and invalidation behavior; the block never owns backend endpoints or credentials.

items.name: console-kit-core
items.title: Constructive Console Kit Core
items.description: The leaf-independent Console Kit shell, runtime, discovery, and single modular Zustand store.
items.docs:
`console-kit-core` installed the shell, runtime, semantic routing, callback boundary, and one per-instance modular Zustand store. Core intentionally includes no feature view, so add selected `console-module-*` items.

Degraded states: explicit endpoint, current `_meta`, introspection, capability, and adapter evidence fail closed independently; installation never grants authority.

Guide: https://constructive-io.github.io/blocks/blocks/console-kit/

items.name: feature-pack-data
items.title: Data Feature Pack
items.description: A current-_meta-only application data explorer with application-table filtering and spreadsheet CRUD.
items.docs:
`feature-pack-data` installed a provider-neutral view and `.constructive/feature-packs/data.json`. Import from `@/blocks/feature-packs/data/data-feature-pack`. The host must supply the view resource, policy, and actions; add `console-module-data` when Console Kit should own discovery and Constructive integration.

Degraded states: The host owns Sheets state and endpoint binding; incompatible metadata stays explicit, and PostgreSQL privileges and RLS decide every query and mutation.

Guide: https://constructive-io.github.io/blocks/blocks/features/data/

items.name: console-module-data
items.title: Data Console Module
items.description: Console Kit navigation, capability discovery, and tenant runtime binding for the Data feature pack.
items.docs:
`console-module-data` installed Console Kit core, the provider-neutral data view, and its Constructive integration. Import from `@/blocks/feature-packs/data/data-console-module` and compose the exported module with `ConstructiveConsoleKitCore`; the install inspector reports the exact import targets and transitive closure.

Degraded states: A missing or incompatible data endpoint, current _meta contract, introspection result, or application table scope keeps Data unavailable; RLS remains authoritative.

Guide: https://constructive-io.github.io/blocks/blocks/features/data/

items.name: feature-pack-auth

Degraded states: Unsupported policy grants or callbacks stay absent, provider failures remain explicit, and callback credentials never enter the view.

Guide: https://constructive-io.github.io/blocks/blocks/features/auth/

Degraded states: Auth requires complete public session, credential, and password flows; pass csrfTokenProvider when required, and keep callback credentials outside Zustand.

Guide: https://constructive-io.github.io/blocks/blocks/features/auth/

items.name: feature-pack-organizations

It never infers a principal, policy grant, or mutation authority; missing resources and callbacks stay unavailable, while PostgreSQL privileges and RLS remain authoritative.

Guide: https://constructive-io.github.io/blocks/blocks/features/organizations/

items.name: console-kit-nextjs

items.description: A full-page Next.js tenant console with semantic routing, auth, dynamic endpoint discovery, first-party adapters, and every feature pack.
items.docs:
`console-kit-nextjs` installed the full Next.js tenant console. Render `ConstructiveConsoleKit` with a secret-free database ID and explicit semantic endpoint map; use presets or selected Console modules for smaller compositions.

Degraded states: every endpoint and module fails closed independently, diagnostics are development-only, credentials never enter Zustand, and PostgreSQL privileges and RLS remain authoritative.

Guide: https://constructive-io.github.io/blocks/blocks/console-kit/

items.name: app-kit-core
items.title: Constructive App Kit Core
items.description: Typed, server-safe application resources, queries, actions, scope partitioning, schema validation, and opt-in client runtime.
items.docs:
Install this root to define Constructive-native application contracts without choosing a view family. Import the client runtime explicitly when a connected view needs TanStack Query. Credentials never belong in definitions or AppScope.

Guide: https://constructive-io.github.io/blocks/blocks/app-kit/

items.name: app-kit-data
items.title: Constructive App Kit Data Views
items.description: Controlled and connected tables, lists, cards, record details, forms, relations, collection controls, and action bars.
items.docs:
Use this root for record and collection applications. Loaders stay server-driven, relation pickers search remotely, ambiguous identities fail read-only, and every view distinguishes loading, empty, denied, and error states.

Guide: https://constructive-io.github.io/blocks/blocks/app-kit/

items.name: app-kit-board
items.title: Constructive App Kit Board
items.description: A typed controlled board and connected resource wrapper with semantic moves, keyboard alternatives, and mutation rollback.
items.docs:
Board movement is disabled until the host supplies an explicit semantic action. Pointer and keyboard moves use the same action contract, restore focus, and roll back optimistic state on denial or failure.

Guide: https://constructive-io.github.io/blocks/blocks/app-kit/

items.name: app-kit-dashboard
items.title: Constructive App Kit Dashboard
items.description: Explicit analytical widgets and a versioned, replaceable layout store on the accessible SVG and SSR foundation from TanStack Charts.
items.docs:
Dashboard widgets always use explicit analytical loaders; they never derive totals from a paginated collection page. Runtime customization is limited to an approved typed catalog, while layout persistence is replaceable.

Guide: https://constructive-io.github.io/blocks/blocks/app-kit/

items.name: app-kit-calendar
items.title: Constructive App Kit Calendar
items.description: Localized controlled month and agenda views with explicit timezones and connected range-query loading.
items.docs:
The host owns record opening and editing, while the connected wrapper loads only the visible range. Recurrence, resource scheduling, and drag rescheduling are intentionally outside V1.

Guide: https://constructive-io.github.io/blocks/blocks/app-kit/

items.name: app-kit-workflow
items.title: Constructive App Kit Workflow UI
items.description: Controlled and connected action surfaces, confirmation and input dialogs, bulk execution, and a multi-step stepper.
items.docs:
This root composes application and server actions into accessible interaction surfaces; it is not a durable workflow engine. Validation, permission failures, cancellation, and partial errors remain explicit.

Guide: https://constructive-io.github.io/blocks/blocks/app-kit/

items.name: app-kit-event-studio
items.title: Constructive App Kit Event Studio
items.description: An opt-in page-scale proof starter combining analytical, collection, board, calendar, relation, form, and action views.
items.docs:
Event Studio pairs with the supported b2b:storage blueprint recipe and demonstrates explicit analytical loaders, semantic board movement, localized range queries, searchable relations, permission-aware actions, and host-controlled URL state. Supply adapters generated from the final executable GraphQL schema.

Guide: https://constructive-io.github.io/blocks/blocks/app-kit/
